meta.name: broken-link-checker
meta.description: Scans a website to find broken links (404s, 500s). Crawls internal pages,  identifies broken outbound links, and reports source pages for easy fixing. Use this when the user asks to "check for broken links", "find 404s",  "audit my links", or "is my site healthy".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描网站找出所有失效链接并报告来源页
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定期检查网站链接健康度，避免用户遇到404错误。
copy.tagline_en: Scan a website to find all broken links and report source pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to regularly check your website for broken links and avoid 404 errors.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描你指定的网站，找出所有返回 404 或 500 等错误状态的链接，并告诉你这些坏链接出现在哪个页面，方便你修复。
howto.when: 当你要求“检查坏链接”、“找 404”、“审计我的链接”或“我的网站健康吗”时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查一下 https://example.com 有没有坏链接。
say.note: Claude 会开始扫描该网站并报告结果。

say.text: 扫描我的网站，找出所有 404 错误。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供网址，然后执行扫描。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will scan a website you specify, find all links that return errors like 404 or 500, and report which pages contain those broken links so you can fix them.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "check for broken links", "find 404s", "audit my links", or "is my site healthy".

say_en.note: Claude will start scanning and report results.

say_en.text: Scan my site and find all 404 errors.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the URL, then run the scan.
